content_text:
Hello Mr. Deakins, Sorry if this has been asked but I love the film Sicario and I have recently been tasked with shooting a film where there is a car interior scene. I am going to try something similar to this car scene, so I would like to ask about the lighting set up that you used for this shots.
Thank you for your time and availability.
